follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy and post-pregnancy until graft failure or maternal death
outcome: Maternal complications of pregnancy (preeclampsia, graft rejection, hemolytic uremic syndrome, maternal hemorrhage, urinary obstruction, cesarean section)
Fetal complications (low gestational age, low birth weight)
cohort: 67 women who had undergone kidney transplantation and experienced 92 pregnancies beyond the first trimester
finding: Pre-pregnancy graft function was found to have a significant impact on both pregnancy outcomes and graft function after kidney transplantation, with lower pre-pregnancy eGFR associated with poorer outcomes.
